title.en: A shared task list still needs separate permissions
title.zh: 事项汇总之后，权限还要逐项检查

summary.en: Follow a community work center from list to detail to action: shared navigation, scoped access and the original business commands.
summary.zh: 结合沭阳之家事项中心，沿着列表、详情、操作三步，检查统一入口怎样保留原业务的权限和处理规则。

basis.en: Code reading of Shuyang Home v1.6.0, pinned to 54ac363. The scenarios below are proposed checks; the project release report is historical evidence, not a full rerun in this note.
basis.zh: 基于沭阳之家 v1.6.0（54ac363）的源码阅读。下文场景是建议验证项；项目发布文档中的测试记录属于该版本验收，本笔记未重新执行全量业务测试。

title.en: A common entry point, different responsibilities
title.zh: 入口可以合并，职责仍然不同

paragraphs.en: A member may be waiting for an activity approval, arranging a resource exchange and following an order. A shared list saves navigation, but each item still has its own owner, state and allowed actions.
paragraphs.zh: 会员可能同时在等活动审核、处理资源交换和跟进订单。把事项放到一个列表里，能减少来回找入口的时间；每条事项属于谁、当前到哪一步、允许做什么，仍由各业务决定。

paragraphs.en: The useful engineering question is what the overview is allowed to do. In this implementation it projects business records into a readable list and returns action metadata; it does not become a second order or moderation service.
paragraphs.zh: 这里值得记录的设计问题是：总览到底负责到哪一层？当前实现把业务记录映射成可读列表，返回可用操作信息；订单和审核的实际处理仍走原业务接口。

title.en: Read the list and detail checks together
title.zh: 把列表和详情的鉴权放在一起读

paragraphs.en: WorkCenter.list filters each record with permitted before producing counts and pages. WorkCenter.target runs that check again when opening a specific object. A link copied earlier therefore does not grant permanent access.
paragraphs.zh: WorkCenter.list 先调用 permitted 过滤记录，再计算数量和分页。通过编号打开详情时，WorkCenter.target 再次检查权限，避免旧链接在角色变化后仍能读取记录。

bullets.en: An organizer does not gain access to other members’ orders through the management overview.
bullets.zh: 组织者不能因为进入管理总览，就读取其他会员的订单。

bullets.en: A moderator remains scoped to assigned boards; a removed assignment must affect subsequent detail requests.
bullets.zh: 版主的范围仍受已分配板块约束；撤销分配后，再次请求详情也应受限。

bullets.en: Forum moderation opens the original viewer so attachments and conversation context remain available.
bullets.zh: 论坛审核回到原查看器，保留图片、语音和上下文，避免只看摘要就作出处理。

title.en: What this structure buys, and what it costs
title.zh: 这种结构解决了什么，又带来什么

paragraphs.en: Reusing the original commands keeps their validation and transaction rules in one place. The price is maintaining mappings for each business type: labels, deadlines, action routes and state groups can drift when a source module changes.
paragraphs.zh: 复用原业务操作，可以把参数校验和事务规则保留在原位置。代价是维护每种业务的映射：名称、截止时间、操作地址和状态分组，都可能在原模块改动后失配。

paragraphs.en: The current list reads records by business type and filters them in the service. That is a concrete choice for this local pilot, not evidence of large-scale performance. A larger deployment would need measured query costs and a deliberate paging strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 当前列表按业务类型读取记录，再在服务层过滤。这是本地试点中的具体实现，不代表大规模查询性能已得到验证。规模扩大后，需要先测查询开销，再决定索引、分页和汇总表怎样设计。

bullets.en: Use member B to request member A’s item directly, not just through the list. Expect denial.
bullets.zh: 用会员 B 直接请求会员 A 的事项编号，而不只检查列表里有没有隐藏，预期应拒绝访问。

bullets.en: Load a moderator’s list, revoke the board assignment, then open its old item URL. Expect fresh authorization.
bullets.zh: 先加载版主列表，再撤销板块权限，最后打开旧详情地址，检查是否重新鉴权。

bullets.en: Remove an activity linked by a signup. The signup should explain that its target is unavailable without breaking unrelated items.
bullets.zh: 移除报名关联的活动，检查该报名是否显示“关联内容不可用”，同时其他事项仍能读取。

bullets.en: After a business action succeeds, refresh the list and its counts from server state. Do not infer completion from a closed dialog.
bullets.zh: 业务操作成功后，用服务端状态刷新列表和数量；不能把关闭弹窗当作办结。

title.en: What I would carry into the next project
title.zh: 我想带到下一个项目里的做法

paragraphs.en: Before building another dashboard, I would write a small table for every item type: who can see it, who can act, which command runs, and what happens when the target disappears. It makes scope concrete before the layout gets complicated.
paragraphs.zh: 以后再做工作台，我会先给每类事项列一张小表：谁能看、谁能办、调用哪个接口、目标消失时如何显示。先把这些关系写清楚，后面的布局和组件拆分才有依据。
